# SSV Insurance — Side-by-Side & UTV Insurance for Sport Builds

> SSV Insurance specializes in agreed value UTV and side-by-side insurance for sport, performance, and competition builds. We cover Polaris RZR, Can-Am Maverick X3, and all major SSV brands across all 50 states.

## What We Do

SSV Insurance is a specialty program from Contractors Choice Agency. We write UTV and side-by-side insurance with proper agreed value coverage, accessories scheduling, and competition endorsements for serious riders and racers.

We are NOT a standard carrier offering basic ATV policies. We are a specialty market for owners with significant aftermarket investment who need real coverage.

## Core Services

- UTV and Side-by-Side Insurance (Agreed Value, Full Coverage)
- Polaris RZR Insurance
- Can-Am Maverick X3 Insurance
- UTV Accessories and Custom Parts Coverage (Scheduled)
- SSV Competition and Racing Insurance (per-event and annual)

## Key Coverage Concepts

**Agreed Value vs. ACV:** Standard policies pay actual cash value — the depreciated market price of your machine. For any UTV with significant aftermarket content, this creates a major coverage gap. We place agreed value policies that pay the full insured amount at total loss.

**Accessories Gap:** Standard CPE limits (00–,000) are inadequate for built sport UTVs. We place scheduled accessories coverage or agreed value policies that cover full accessory investment.

**Competition Exclusion:** Standard UTV policies exclude on-course racing use. We offer per-event and annual competition endorsements for desert racing, short-course, rock crawl, and organized events.
